caption: The drawing depicts a wooden doll with articulated joints, shown against a plain beige background. The doll has a torso that narrows at the waist and widens at the shoulders, with two arms and two legs that are attached with visible joints at the shoulders, elbows, hips, and knees. The head is oval-shaped and painted in a light flesh tone, featuring black hair, black eyes, a small red mouth, and faintly blushed cheeks. The limbs and torso are rendered in natural wood tones with shading to indicate the contours and the roundness of the wood. The right arm is shown slightly bent outward at the elbow, while the left arm hangs straight down. The legs are straight and parallel. There are no objects except the doll, and the composition is centered with the doll occupying the middle of the paper. The name "Rex Bush" is written in cursive at the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Doll - "Clarissa"
